department: IMPRS for Solar System Science (Solar System School)

deadline.value: Apply any time for advertised open projects; applications are reviewed in several rounds a year. The 2025/26 call rounds closed Feb 1, Jun 1 and Oct 1, 2026; dates for the next rounds were not yet published when checked
deadline.quote: Applications may be submitted through the online portal at any time and will be reviewed on a regular basis. | Candidates can choose to submit their application (for open projects only) at any time.

also.quote: Timelines for application submissions in 2025/2026 ... 2026 October 1 Latest deadline for submission of application

gre_subject.value: GRE Physics (or Chemistry) highly recommended if your master's is from outside Europe; such applicants with scores get preference (not for geoscience projects)
gre_subject.quote: GRE Physics or GRE Chemistry subject test scores or equivalent are highly recommended for candidates who have obtained their Master's degree at a university outside of Europe. | Applicants with university degrees obtained outside Europe who provide GRE physics or chemistry test scores will be given preference over those who do not provide test scores.

supervisor.value: Contacting faculty first is not mandatory (it may help); a committee screens applications and the potential supervisor makes the final decision
supervisor.quote: While it is not mandatory to contact the members of our faculty before sending your application, your chances of getting accepted into the programme may increase if you have gotten a particular potential advisor interested in working with you. | The final decision about the acceptance of a student rests with their potential supervisors.

funding.value: Usually a doctoral support contract at 75% of TVöD E13 (about EUR 2,400 net/month on average); some students are on third-party scholarships. The 2025/26 call offered successful applicants a 3.5-year contract plus wrap-up funding
funding.quote: Doctoral candidates are usually employed on a doctoral support contract. | Some are funded through third-party scholarships. | the net income after deductions can be expected to amount to 2400 EUR on average per month

also.quote: Successful applicants will be offered a 3,5-year doctoral support contract with remuneration dependent on TVöD (75% E13) according to the German public salary scale, as well as wrap-up funding.

entry_route.value: M.Sc. or equivalent (with a written master's thesis) held or about to be obtained; apply only once you have started your master's thesis
entry_route.quote: They must have, or must be about to obtain, an M.Sc. degree or equivalent in physics, chemistry, geosciences or a related field, including a written Masters thesis

also.quote: please only apply after you have at least started to work on your Master’s thesis project.

notes: Solar/stellar physics, planetary science and geoscience projects; choose up to three advertised open projects. Degree awarded by University of Göttingen or TU Braunschweig. The funding page says three-year contracts; the call and FAQ say 3.5 years.
name: Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS), with University of Göttingen and TU Braunschweig
